question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

It is of **__paramount__** importance that you read the instructions before attempting the test.
solution: The correct answer is **"Central."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Paramount"** means "of the utmost importance." (सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण) • **Example**: *Safety is **paramount**__ in car design.* • **"Central"** means "at the heart of something; of prime importance." (सर्वाधिक महत्वपूर्ण; मुख्‍य) __ • **Example**: *The film’s **central**__ character is a fifteen-year-old girl.* • Both words convey the idea of something being very important. • **"Central"** is a synonym of **"paramount"** in this context. • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Remind"**, means to bring something back to someone's attention, but it is not a synonym of "paramount". (किसी को कुछ याद दिलाना (विशेषतः किसी ख़ास बात के लिए)) • **"Rephrase"**, means to express something in a different way, but it is not a synonym of "paramount". (किसी चीज़ को अलग तरीके से व्यक्त करना) • **"Rehearse"**, means to practice something, but it is not a synonym of "paramount". (पूर्वाभ्यास करना) 36:Tb30, The correct answer is **"Dark."**
